title: Privacy Policy
intro:
At Taptales Studio, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, store, and protect information when you visit our website or use our applications, games, and related services.
body:
## Information We Collect

Depending on the Services you use, we may collect the following categories of information.

### Information You Provide

- Name, email address, or contact details.
- Account registration information.
- Customer support messages and feedback.
- Information you voluntarily submit through our Services.

### Automatically Collected Information

- Device type, operating system, and application version.
- Device or advertising identifiers, where applicable.
- IP address and approximate location derived from it.
- App interactions, gameplay activity, and usage statistics.
- Crash reports, diagnostic data, and performance information.

We collect these categories only where relevant to the particular Service and as described in any applicable product-specific privacy notice.

## How We Use Information

We may use collected information to:

- Operate, maintain, and improve our applications and games.
- Save gameplay progress and user preferences.
- Analyze performance and improve user experience.
- Identify bugs and resolve technical issues.
- Provide customer support.
- Prevent fraud, cheating, and unauthorized activities.
- Display or measure advertising, where applicable.
- Comply with legal obligations.

Where required, we rely on an appropriate legal basis, such as consent, contractual necessity, legitimate interests, or compliance with legal obligations.

## Advertising and Analytics

Some of our applications and games may use third-party advertising or analytics services.

Depending on the specific product, these may include:

- Google AdMob
- Google Firebase Analytics
- Google Play Services
- Other providers identified in the applicable product privacy notice.

These services may process device identifiers, usage information, or advertising-related data according to their own privacy policies.

We will request consent where required and provide applicable privacy choices.

**Important:** The services listed above are examples and must be updated to reflect the providers actually integrated into each product.

## Cookies and Similar Technologies

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to support essential functionality, understand website usage, and remember preferences.

Where non-essential cookies are used, we will provide the notices and consent controls required by applicable law.

You can also manage cookies through your browser settings.

## Data Sharing

We do not sell personal information in exchange for money.

We may share information with trusted service providers who help us operate our Services, including hosting, analytics, advertising, payment processing, and customer support providers.

We may also disclose information when legally required or necessary to protect our rights and users.

Certain advertising disclosures may qualify as "sharing" or "sale" under applicable privacy laws even without a monetary transaction. Where relevant, we provide the required notices and opt-out options.

## Data Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

However, no internet-based system can guarantee absolute security.

## Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, including providing Services, maintaining security, resolving disputes, and meeting legal obligations.

Retention periods depend on the type of information and the relevant Service.

When information is no longer required, we delete or anonymize it where reasonably practicable, unless further retention is legally required.

## Children's Privacy

Our applications and games may have different intended audiences and age ratings.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable laws.

Where a Service is directed to children or permits child users, we apply the relevant age-appropriate privacy protections and parental consent requirements.

If you believe a child has provided personal information inappropriately, please contact us so we can investigate and take appropriate action.

## Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights to:

- Request access to your personal information.
- Request correction of inaccurate information.
- Request deletion of your information.
- Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
- Object to or restrict certain processing.
- Request data portability where applicable.
- Opt out of certain advertising-related data uses.

You may exercise applicable rights by contacting us at support@taptales.net.

We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling certain requests.

## Account and Data Deletion

If an application supports user accounts, you may request account deletion through the options provided within the application or by following its published account deletion instructions.

Where applicable, we will also provide an accessible web-based account deletion request method.

Account deletion may result in the loss of saved progress, preferences, and other associated information.

Some records may be retained where legally required or permitted.

## International Data Transfers

Our Services may be operated using infrastructure or service providers located in different countries.

When personal information is transferred internationally, we apply safeguards required by applicable data protection laws.

## External Links

Our website and applications may contain links to external websites or services.

We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third parties and encourage users to review their respective policies.

## Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically.

Any changes will be reflected by the updated date at the top of this page. We will provide additional notice where required by law.

## Contact Us

For privacy-related questions or requests, contact:

- **Studio:** Taptales Studio
- **Website:** taptales.net
- **Privacy Email:** support@taptales.net
